dedupe_keys.name: geoportal hessen de emergency and critical facilities datasets

description: geoportal.hessen.de: emergency and critical facilities datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.hessen.de. Coverage: the area served by geoportal.hessen.de. The listing groups 27 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about emergency and critical facilities; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Rettungswachen Main-Taunus-Kreis - us-govserv:GovernmentalService - OG; Rettungswachen Kreis Groß-Gerau - ft2:Rettungswachen - OGC API Feature; Rettungswachen Kreis Groß-Gerau - ft2:Rettungsbezirke - OGC API Featur; Rettungswachen Hochtaunuskreis - ft2:Rettungswachen - OGC WFS Interfac. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
